title: НА + accusative: For a week, the next day

blocks.text: НА + Accusative indicates how long something is expected to last.

items.head: The preposition НА + Acc. is used:
points: to indicate the length of time one expects to stay some place, or the time something is expected to last
after the verb опаздывать / опоздать to indicate the amount of time by which someone is late

items.text: Note also such expressions as: на следующий день — (next day).

blocks.text: DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 73. One sentence at a time, in a new order each time you open this chapter; it is finished when every one has been answered right. The sentences are real: the source of each is shown with it.

exercises.q: Наша прапрабабушка умерла на ___ (следующий день) после рождения моей старшей сестры.
exercises.prompt: Our great-great-grandmother died the day after my elder sister was born.
exercises.why: «The preposition НА + Acc. is used: (a) to indicate the length of time one expects to stay some place, or the time something is expected to last; (b) after the verb опаздывать / опоздать to indicate the amount of time by which someone is late.» «Note also such expressions as: на следующий день — (next day).» — DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 73.
exercises.context: НА + Accusative indicates how long something is expected to last. (DLI, Lesson 73)
